acquisition_technique.selected_technique: fresh Chrome/Edge CDP context -> public rendered TikTok discovery -> canonical URL extraction -> official TikTok oEmbed/public-page verification -> destroy context -> repeat in a new context

operation_counting.provider_reached_operation: One deliberate top-level TikTok navigation or explicit official verification call that receives a TikTok response.
operation_counting.preconnect_failure: One deliberate acquisition operation that fails before any TikTok response.
operation_counting.browser_subresources: Automatically page-initiated subresources are summarized as navigation telemetry, not separately initiated budget operations; their URLs, headers, cookies and bodies are not persisted or replayed.

acquisition_technique.freeze_rule: Do not freeze the technique or create downstream adapter artifacts until two independent fresh-context rounds reproduce the final official record set.

authorized_files_or_modules: services/data-acquisition/coordination/v1/** and coordination/queue.json (append-only P58 handoff records only)
explicit_out_of_scope: login, credentials, account authorization or authenticated/private data
CAPTCHA solving, anti-bot bypass, signature emulation, proxy rotation or access-control bypass
persistent cookies, cookie values, browser profiles, storage state, cache, raw netlogs, raw headers or raw response bodies
direct replay of undocumented/private endpoints discovered from browser traffic
comments, captions, transcripts or follower enrichment
paid scraping/proxy services or new spending
production write, recurring scheduling or main modification
validation_profile: P57 evidence continuity and inherited-artifact byte identity
single-operation network preflight before any batch
provider-reached and preconnect ledgers with separate hard limits
sanitized rendered-DOM/first-party public-response extraction without raw sensitive persistence
five valid records per topic with stable IDs and canonical URLs
official verification of every retained URL in two independent fresh contexts
context close, temporary profile deletion and zero persisted cookie/storage-state proof
fixture replay through unchanged Generic Runner
MTC, early acquisition quality gate and Analysis handoff
V1/V2 byte invariants plus immutable V3 lineage and exact resolution
targeted tests, exact-head full corpus, Data Acquisition CI, one PR, squash merge and post-merge verification
